title: Jacobs and Hopkins conclude abductions began mid-to-late 1800s

tellings.quote: he and Bud Hopkins had concluded that the abduction that the abduction phenomenon began in the mid to late 1800s

plain: Two researchers of alien abduction claims, David Jacobs and Budd Hopkins, are said to have concluded that people only started being taken by beings in the middle to late 1800s. The researcher Tim Alberino passes this on from what Jacobs told him, saying that Jacobs "and Bud Hopkins had concluded" the abductions began then. If so, the experience would have a starting point in history rather than going back forever.
